Privacy Policy

How American Clothing Restoration handles website privacy and contact information.

Information We Collect

This website is designed for direct contact by phone and directions. It does not include a contact form, quote form, newsletter signup, or email capture.

If you call American Clothing Restoration, any information you choose to provide is handled as part of that direct conversation.

Website Analytics and Cookies

This site may use essential cookies required for basic website functionality. Non-essential cookies, if enabled, are used only with your consent to understand general website activity and improve the site experience.
